saw_lines: Shoppers of underwear and basics decide on fit and feel, then reorder the same cut without comparing again.
So a first-time buyer decides in the opening line whether to click, and an offer there gives a reason to act.
Your ads carry no offer: 0 of 26 copy ads mention the 10% off first order that your site shows. Put it in the first line of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 26 copy ads mention it, so a new buyer has no push to buy. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads, and on the creative.
None of your 26 copy ads carries a proof number, so a buyer has no number to trust. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open three new ads with it.

Your 26 copy ads open with 15 different stories, and the biggest opens only 6, so no opener is built out. Keep the two best, the sieht zart aus and light touch TENCEL openers, and build the next batch on those.

Your 8 ads have run 60+ days, so they are proven winners, but one winner alone leaves no fresh copy for the same buyers. Build three more variations of the oldest winning video, changing the opening line and the color shown.

ads_1: First-order offer creative built on the sieht zart aus and light touch openers
